newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CADETE SCORES AGAIN AS CELTIC WIN AWAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CADETE SCORES AGAIN AS CELTIC WIN AWAY.

text.p: Portuguese striker Jorge Cadete scored his 27th goal of the season to give Glasgow Celtic a 1-0 away win at Motherwell on Saturday.
Cadete, who missed Celtic's last match to play in a friendly international, rounded Motherwell goalkeeper Scott Howie to score after 10 minutes.
Celtic dominated the rest of the match but failed to build on Cadete's strike.
Ttheir victory closed the gap to four points on league leaders Rangers who play Hibernian at Ibrox on Sunday.
Ray McKinnon scored a hat-trick, all from direct free kicks, to give third-placed Dundee United a 3-2 win at Kilmarnock.
Dunfermline recorded their first home victory over Aberdeen for 25 years, winning 3-0 to move away from the relegation zone.
